unauthorized: The provider refused the key: it was revoked, expired, mistyped, or made in another account or project.
Make a new key on the key page above and paste it with --repair (or --add <provider>); the test runs before anything is written.
no-credit: The key is accepted, but the account has no credit or quota left: top up, raise the key's limit, or wait for the free allowance to reset.
rate-limited: The key was accepted (429 comes after authentication): a free daily or per-minute allowance is used up. Test again later; nothing to repair.
wrong-base: The URL did not answer as a model list: the provider moved its API, or a base URL field is wrong.

A base in a Vault field (bazaarlink_api_base, cohere_api_base, watsonx_api_base) is fixed with --repair; a base the catalogue env names is fixed in JorisJonkers-dev/litellm deploy/env/litellm-catalog/base.env.
server-error: The provider answered 5xx: an outage on its side. Test again later; nothing to repair.
network: No HTTP answer from this workstation: DNS, TLS, a firewall, or the provider is down. The local route needs the tailnet.
needs-extra-field: The route needs a field besides the key; --repair (or --add <provider>) asks for it.
unproven: The model list answers without any key, so its answer says nothing about this key. The catalogue's own probe decides: check the MODELS column after a run (--sync).

providers.name: GitHub token: publish the catalogue
providers.requirements: Org default policy is 'Require administrator approval' for fine-grained tokens (owners' own tokens are auto-approved); default max lifetime 366 days unless the org changes it. Org may block fine-grained tokens entirely.
steps: Repository JorisJonkers-dev/litellm-model-catalog; permission Contents: Read and write.
Open https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens/new (Settings > Developer settings > Personal access tokens > Fine-grained tokens > Generate new token)
Enter a token name, choose an expiration, optionally a description
Set Resource owner to JorisJonkers-dev (organizations that block fine-grained tokens do not appear in the list)
If the org requires approval, enter a justification
Under Repository access choose 'Only select repositories' and pick the single repository
Under Permissions > Repository permissions set Contents to Read and write (Metadata read is the base permission for GET /repos)
For the second token also set Pull requests to Read and write
Click 'Generate token' and copy it
If the org requires approval the token is pending (public read only) until an owner approves; owner-created tokens are approved automatically
providers.verified_note: Fetched GitHub docs: managing-your-personal-access-tokens (steps, org approval pending behaviour), org PAT policy page (default approval required, 366 days), permissions-required page (GET /repos needs Metadata read; contents/pulls endpoints), repos REST page (permissions object of booleans admin/maintain/push/triage/pull). Not confirmed on a page: the github_pat_ prefix, exact UI labels for the permission dropdowns.

unauthorized: 401: token expired, revoked or mistyped
403/404 on the repo: token is pending org approval, wrong resource owner, or repo not in the selected repositories
Write access appears as permissions.push true in the repo response; check Contents is Read and write
Use Authorization: Bearer or token; add X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28 if needed
